'''Craig Blair''' is an American voice actor who worked for the English-language dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Pokémon roles==
Blair joined up with {{aniseries|PTS}} after the dubbing of the series was put under the control of [[The Pokémon Company International|Pokémon USA]]. Since then, he has voiced several different characters for the series. His most notable roles are that of {{Tracey}} and {{an|Giovanni}}, both of which were originally done by [[Ted Lewis|Ed Paul]].

Blair left the {{pkmn|animated series}} at the end of [[S12|season 12]], with his recurring roles of Contest judges [[Raoul Contesta|Contesta]] and [[Mr. Sukizo]] going to [[Mike Pollock]] (Contesta's original voice actor) and [[Tom Wayland]] at the start of the [[S13|13th season]]. Ed Paul previously returned to his role as {{an|Giovanni}}.
